title: the minimap is off by default; one Settings row turns it on
why: His order (2026-10-20): "remove minimap entirely, i guess make it an option in settings but default to leaving it off". The MINIMAP row now has OFF first and OFF is the usual, then small, standard and large (the old on/off row is gone, one control per job). A save that held a minimap size moves to off once (P.mmOff1). With it off nothing is drawn and the run info panel and the corner sit up under the money block.
now: No minimap in raids unless you turn it on in Settings.

edits.replacement: if(CFG.minimap===0||!mmOn()) return false;   // v33.35 (cw-mmoff): the Settings row says OFF
